headlines.title: 16-Year-Old Opens Fire at Elementary School, Killing 4
headlines.description: Vigils are being held in Bend, Oregon, after a 16-year-old gunman opened fire at Silver Rail elementary school, killing four young students and a teacher. NBC’s Liz Kreutz reports and law and intelligence correspondent Tom Winter joins TODAY to weigh-in on the investigation.

headlines.title: Trump looms as tensions flare in final Maine Senate debate
headlines.description: The marathon of debates in the Maine Senate race has ended, but there is still one unanswered question: Just how large will President Donald Trump loom in November?

headlines.title: Alaska Senate candidates clash over the Iran war, high prices and their times in office
headlines.description: The two major candidates vying for an Alaska Senate seat squared off Thursday night over issues ranging from the war with Iran to controversies during the Democratic nominee’s time in Congress in a debate that at times flared into personal attacks.

headlines.title: Trump says Ukraine resuming strikes on Russian oil sites is a ‘disgrace’
headlines.description: President Donald Trump has labeled Ukraine’s resumption of strikes on Russian oil refineries a “disgrace,” the latest salvo in his campaign to pressure the U.S. ally over rising gas prices that could cost Republicans in next month’s midterm elections.

headlines.title: Amber Guyger, ex-police officer convicted of murder, is released on parole
headlines.description: Guyger served seven years of a 10-year sentence in the 2018 killing of Botham Jean, who lived in the same apartment complex.

headlines.title: Elon Musk shows off ‘flying’ Tesla Roadster after years of delays
headlines.description: Elon Musk showed off the new Tesla Roadster prototype Thursday that can briefly launch itself into the air using rocket-inspired thrusters.

headlines.title: After a failed World Series bid, Dodgers left wondering what happened to their season and star
headlines.description: The Los Angeles Dodgers’ push to win a third straight World Series ended officially Thursday, swept by the Milwaukee Brewers in the National League Championship Series. Lack of production from their superstar is a reason why.

headlines.title: Mother of 'Breaking Bad' actor RJ Mitte reflects on her son's legacy following his death at 34
headlines.description: The mother of "Breaking Bad" actor RJ Mitte, who died at age 34, speaks to NBC News' Chloe Melas about her son's legacy. Dana Mitte, who found her son's body after his apparent suicide, says she hopes to save others from experiencing the pain of losing a child under such tragic circumstances.

headlines.title: Trump pardons two vehicle repair shop owners during Alaska rally
headlines.description: During his rally in Alaska, President Trump pardoned Zachary Czuback and Patrick Fleming, co-owners of a vehicle repair shop in Anchorage. Both pleaded guilty in 2022 to violating the Clean Air Act by tampering with federally mandated and monitored devices that tracked vehicles’ diesel emissions.

headlines.title: Oregon school shooter identified as 16-year-old whose mother purchased the gun he used, sources say
headlines.description: A teen accused of gunning down three children and a teacher at an Oregon elementary school on Thursday has been identified as John J. Griffin II, three senior law enforcement sources briefed on the investigation told NBC News.
